method: Ran the registered shell drill against ephemeral PostgreSQL 18.0-bookworm source and fresh target containers. App and receiver databases were dumped separately with pg_dump -Fc and restored with pg_restore --exit-on-error. No provider endpoint was called.
limitations: Synthetic schema and rows only; not the Stage 4/5 application schema or production data
Logical pg_dump restore only; no WAL/PITR, base backup verification, backup-time failure, RTO/RPO measurement, worker kill, or network partition
The drill checks restored state and receiver count; it does not exercise an automatic reconcile/retry workflow
